agent_explanation: Controller force violates fmax after a body-body collision. At step 28 bodies 0 and 1 are in near-contact (gap ~0.005) with low controller force. The collision impulse at step 29 gives body 0 a large velocity jump (speed 2.9 -> 10.27, vy -2.14 -> +8.42). The velocity-error controller computes force = kp * (v_desired - v_actual) which scales with the post-impact velocity error (kp 26.76) to ~487 N, exceeding fmax 72.67 without effective clamping. Lowering kp to 5 keeps the same collision but keeps the computed force within/at the limit (clamped), proving the gain vs limit interaction is the cause.
